types.label: Data Matrix
types.hint: Any text. Small and sturdy; common on parts, labels and packaging.

types.label: GS1 DataMatrix
types.hint: GS1 data as (AI)value pairs: product number (01), expiry date (17, YYMMDD), batch (10), serial (21)…

types.label: Aztec
types.hint: Any text. Used on train and plane tickets; needs no blank border.

types.label: PDF417
types.hint: Any text. A wide, stacked code used on boarding passes, ID cards and shipping labels.

types.label: EAN-13
types.hint: 12 digits; the check digit is added for you. With it, 13.

types.label: EAN-8
types.hint: 7 digits; the check digit is added for you. With it, 8.

types.label: UPC-A
types.hint: 11 digits; the check digit is added for you. With it, 12.

types.label: UPC-E
types.hint: 6 digits (or 7 with number system 0/1; 8 with check digit). Compact barcode for small packages.

types.label: ISBN
types.hint: An ISBN-10 or ISBN-13; hyphens are fine. Leave off the check digit and it's added; type it and it's checked.

types.label: Code 128
types.hint: Letters, digits and symbols. For IDs, tickets, asset tags and inventory.

types.label: GS1-128
types.hint: GS1 data as (AI)value pairs, e.g. shipping container code (00), product (01), batch (10).

types.label: ITF-14
types.hint: 13 digits; the check digit is added for you. With it, 14. Used on outer cartons.

types.label: Code 39
types.hint: Capital letters, digits, spaces and - . $ / + %. Common on ID badges and older systems.
